name: Maneuver Amplifier - Guard
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Guard capability.

61235.name: Improved Movement I · Guard
61235.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When performing Guard, Crit RES <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit DMG RES <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
